text:
rene_pd: quick thread to lock down the "Admission Fallback" behavior and default SLA matrix for reserved pools. Customers keep asking what happens when a guaranteed admission request can't be served immediately.
adar_sh: TL;DR: three fallback strategies we discussed: 1) queue-with-timeout (wait then reject), 2) best-effort-spill (route to opportunistic lane or smaller model), 3) immediate-reject with clear error + guidance. Need a default.
mika_eng: runtime notes:
- queue-with-timeout is straightforward but risks head-of-line blocking and latency spikes.
- best-effort-spill requires model-variant routing + cost accounting; adds complexity but improves success rate.
- immediate-reject is simplest and safest for cluster stability.
zoe_ops: ops perspective: queueing increases operational surface (longer-live requests), we saw cascading issues in previous release. Best-effort spill is attractive if we can enforce tenant-priority and observe clear billing tags.
carmen_sales: field reports: Enterprise customers expect a predictable outcome. They prefer queue-with-timeout combined with a "fallthrough" option to best-effort-spill for non-critical calls.
infra-bot: metric checklist: admission_fail_rate, average_queue_time, spillover_count, fallback_success_rate.
rene_pd: proposal: default = immediate-reject with a standardized error code + actionable guidance. Offer opt-in policies per-tenant: QUEUE_WITH_TIMEOUT or BEST_EFFORT_SPILL. Also offer a paid "Fallthrough SLA" that enables queue-with-timeout + spill two-tier fallback.
adar_sh: rationale: minimize blast radius by keeping default conservative. Customers who need softer behavior can opt in and sign up for the SLA.
mika_eng: implementation sketch:
```
admission_policy:
  default: IMMEDIATE_REJECT
  options:
    - QUEUE_WITH_TIMEOUT: {timeout_s: 30}
    - BEST_EFFORT_SPILL: {fallback_model: "gptq-quant", route_cost_tag: "spill"}
  paid_sla: FALLTHROUGH_SLAB
```
zoe_ops: rollout plan:
1) add runtime admission flag per-tenant behind FF
2) build standardized error payload with guidance URL and quota state
3) implement QUEUE_WITH_TIMEOUT with safeguards (max queue per pool, request-circuit)
4) implement BEST_EFFORT_SPILL routing to quantized variants
5) canary pilot with 5 customers for each opt-in variant
carmen_sales: pricing and contract notes: FALLTHROUGH_SLAB = monthly premium + per-hour queue surcharge. Need sample SLA wording: "Fallthrough SLA provides a queue window and best-effort fallback; not a hard guarantee of completion under declared emergency." Legal must draft.
rene_pd: launch criteria suggestion:
- runtime: admission flag + error payload + basic QUEUE_WITH_TIMEOUT
- ops: canary with synthetic saturation showing queue doesn't increase error rate >5%
- metrics: admission_fail_rate reduction for opt-ins, no more than 3 reclaim incidents in pilot
- docs: clear guidance page and SDK error handling examples
adar_sh: timeline: basic IMMEDIATE_REJECT + error payload = 1 sprint. QUEUE_WITH_TIMEOUT = 2 sprints. BEST_EFFORT_SPILL = 3-4 sprints depending on route support.
mika_eng: edge-cases to consider: multi-region pools (tie-breaker for queued requests), cross-tenant affinity, and when queued requests block autoscaler signals.
zoe_ops: runbook additions: alert on queue-depth per-pool, automated ramp-down policy if queue grows > threshold, and a customer notification template for queued/rejected events.
carmen_sales: pilot ask: sign up 6 customers across self-serve and enterprise. We'll offer the paid Fallthrough SLA to 2 enterprise customers for the pilot.
infra-bot: checklist created: ["error-payload-spec","admission-ff","queue-metrics","spill-routing-rfc","billing-sku-draft"]
rene_pd: decision: ship IMMEDIATE_REJECT default with a rich error payload now. Start work on QUEUE_WITH_TIMEOUT as an opt-in feature and design the FALLTHROUGH_SLAB pricing/contract in parallel. BEST_EFFORT_SPILL deprioritized until we validate queue behavior.
mika_eng: agreed. I'll put up an RFC for queue design and post PR for error payload by EOD.
zoe_ops: will draft runbook and create canary alerts. Carmen please line up pilot customers.
carmen_sales: will reach out to likely candidates and coordinate legal for pilot SLAs.
rene_pd: thanks team. We'll reconvene after the RFC review and when the canary channel is ready. :thumbsup:
